The following are instructions provided by the tool server 'tessl':
---[start of server instructions]---
Tessl gives coding agents the context they need to work in a repository, and the tools to build and run agent workflows.

This server exposes 34 tools: finding_create, finding_link_add, finding_link_remove, finding_list, finding_update, finding_view, install, login, new_plugin, outdated, project_list, review_fix, review_run, review_view, schedule_create, schedule_delete, schedule_list, schedule_pause, schedule_resume, schedule_runs, schedule_trigger, schedule_update, schedule_validate, schedule_view, search, skill_publish, skills_available, status, tile_publish, uninstall, update, workspace_create, workspace_list, workspace_list_members. Call `tools/list` for each one's description and input schema.

Everything else is in the `tessl` CLI, which describes itself. Run `AGENT=1 tessl` for the full command surface, then `tessl <command> --help` for one command's arguments and flags. Do not guess flags, because they are documented per command and can change.
---[end of server instructions]---
</project_context>

Finish only material Stage 4 persistence/reliability gaps in this Tessl workspace. Keep the implemented architecture and API. No broad spec audit, redesign or approval questions. Update native specs/tasks before corrections. Do not read siblings, previous stages or evaluation folders. Unit/build/browser checks already passed in the initial session; do not repeat unaffected successful suites.

Observed defects to fix together:
- Start-Services.ps1 unconditionally deletes identity.db, commerce.db and reviews.db on every normal start. This destroys users, pending events and projection state. Preserve service-owned stores across normal stop/start. Isolate test data via temporary DB paths/env/working dirs or an explicit test-only reset, never automatic destructive startup. Use stable absolute paths, hidden/logged processes, node + local Vite JS with --host 127.0.0.1, readiness and owned PID cleanup; remove broad kill-by-port fallback from normal stop. Stop only owned trees. The CLI shell waits for startup descendants; verify start/HTTP/stop within one command or a truly detached host, not an infinite keepalive.
- Commerce currently basic_nack(requeue=False)s failures without any DLQ or retry topology. Add a concise bounded retry/dead-letter policy with durable queues/messages and manual ack after durable processing; retain idempotence. Envelope must carry version alongside event_id/correlation/type/timestamp/payload. Keep outbox transactional and confirmed publication; use mandatory routing/handle unroutable publication so accepted events cannot be silently marked sent when no route exists. Do not delete queues during normal reconnect.
- Moderation currently publishes only approvals although the endpoint accepts rejection of an already approved review. Ensure any accepted rejection cannot leave a stale public projection/cache entry visible (either support a rejection event or enforce a coherent terminal-state contract).

Add and execute one isolated real-RabbitMQ subprocess acceptance suite, not a local helper replicating consumer logic: create/moderate over the actual gateway, stop commerce only, approve while it is offline and confirm the broker/outbox accepted the change, restart commerce and prove public projection recovery; republish the exact event ID and verify no second effect; run this test's reviews publisher against an unavailable AMQP endpoint, accept moderation, verify pending outbox survives service restart, restore real AMQP and prove delivery. Add a poison-message DLQ assertion and a normal launcher stop/start persistence check. Broker is already running at stage4-runtime.json; do not stop/administer the shared broker or other vhosts. Use unique queues/namespaces and temporary DBs for tests.

Refresh affected backend coverage and CI/docs/tasks for these changes. Preserve frontend lcov/build/browser evidence; rerun frontend checks only if affected code actually changes. Docker and remote CI were not executed. End with precise executed evidence and limitations.

# Start-Services.ps1
# PowerShell script to launch and verify all Stage 4 microservices locally

Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Starting E-Commerce Microservices (Stage 4)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Ensure local SQLite DB files are clean or initialized
# Each Python service initializes its own SQLite DB file on startup.
Remove-Item -Path "backend\identity.db", "backend\commerce.db", "backend\reviews.db" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item -Path "identity.db", "commerce.db", "reviews.db" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# 1. Start Identity Service (Port 18401)
$identityProc = Start-Process -FilePath "uvicorn" -ArgumentList "app.identity:app --port 18401 --host 127.0.0.1" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$identityPid = $identityProc.Id
Write-Host "Launched Identity Service (PID: $identityPid)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# 2. Start Commerce Service (Port 18402)
$commerceProc = Start-Process -FilePath "uvicorn" -ArgumentList "app.commerce:app --port 18402 --host 127.0.0.1" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$commercePid = $commerceProc.Id
Write-Host "Launched Commerce Service (PID: $commercePid)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# 3. Start Reviews Service (Port 18403)
$reviewsProc = Start-Process -FilePath "uvicorn" -ArgumentList "app.reviews:app --port 18403 --host 127.0.0.1" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$reviewsPid = $reviewsProc.Id
Write-Host "Launched Reviews Service (PID: $reviewsPid)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# 4. Start Gateway Service (Port 18400)
$gatewayProc = Start-Process -FilePath "uvicorn" -ArgumentList "app.gateway:app --port 18400 --host 127.0.0.1" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$gatewayPid = $gatewayProc.Id
Write-Host "Launched Gateway Service (PID: $gatewayPid)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# 5. Start Frontend Service (Port 18500)
$frontendProc = Start-Process -FilePath "npm.cmd" -ArgumentList "run dev -- --port 18500 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1" -WorkingDirectory "frontend" -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$frontendPid = $frontendProc.Id
Write-Host "Launched Frontend Service (PID: $frontendPid)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# Save PIDs to a JSON file for easy stop management
$pids = @{
    identity = $identityPid
    commerce = $commercePid
    reviews = $reviewsPid
    gateway = $gatewayPid
    frontend = $frontendPid
} | ConvertTo-Json

$pids | Out-File -FilePath "services-pids.json" -Encoding utf8

# Deterministic Readiness Checks
Write-Host "Running readiness port checks..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$ports = @(18401, 18402, 18403, 18400, 18500)
$allReady = $true

foreach ($port in $ports) {
    $ready = $false
    for ($i = 1; $i -le 30; $i++) {
        try {
            $conn = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient("127.0.0.1", $port)
            $conn.Close()
            $ready = $true
            break
        } catch {
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
        }
    }
    if ($ready) {
        Write-Host "Port $port is active and listening." -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
        Write-Host "Port $port failed to start within timeout limit." -ForegroundColor Red
        $allReady = $false
    }
}

if ($allReady) {
    Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "All Stage 4 microservices launched successfully!" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Warning: Some microservices failed to respond." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
}

    return reviews_list

@app.post("/api/checkout")
async def simulated_checkout(payload: CheckoutRequest, authorization: str | None = Header(None)):
    user_info = await verify_internal_token(authorization)
    username = user_info["username"]

    summary_items = []
    total_amount = 0.0

    # Read products from DB
    with get_db() as conn:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT * FROM products")
        db_products = {r["id"]: dict(r) for r in cur.fetchall()}

    for cart_item in payload.items:
        prod_id = cart_item.product_id
        qty = cart_item.quantity

        product = db_products.get(prod_id)
        if not product:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=f"Product with ID {prod_id} was not found in the catalog"
            )

        if not bool(product["availability"]):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                detail=f"Product '{product['name']}' is currently out of stock"
            )

        item_total = round(product["price"] * qty, 2)
        summary_items.append({
            "product_id": prod_id,
            "name": product["name"],
            "price": product["price"],
            "quantity": qty,
            "item_total": item_total
        })
        total_amount += item_total

    total_amount = round(total_amount, 2)

    return {
        "message": "Fictitious checkout completed successfully. No real charge has been made, and no payment gateway was contacted.",
        "summary": {
            "items": summary_items,
            "total_amount": total_amount,
            "buyer": username
        }
    }

def outbox_publisher_loop():
    print("[Outbox Worker] Thread started.")
    while True:
        try:
            params = pika.URLParameters(AMQP_URL)
            connection = pika.BlockingConnection(params)
            channel = connection.channel()
            # Enable publisher confirmations
            channel.confirm_delivery()
            # Declare exchange
            channel.exchange_declare(exchange=EXCHANGE, exchange_type='direct', durable=True)
            
            print("[Outbox Worker] Connected to RabbitMQ.")
            
            while True:
                with get_db() as conn:
                    cur = conn.cursor()
                    cur.execute("SELECT id, event_type, payload FROM outbox WHERE processed = 0 ORDER BY id ASC")
                    rows = cur.fetchall()
                
                if not rows:
                    time.sleep(1)
                    continue
                
                for row in rows:
                    event_id = row["id"]
                    payload_str = row["payload"]
                    
                    try:
                        channel.basic_publish(
                            exchange=EXCHANGE,
                            routing_key=ROUTING_KEY,
                            body=payload_str,
                            properties=pika.BasicProperties(
                                delivery_mode=2,  # persistent message
                                content_type='application/json'
                            )
                        )
                        with get_db() as conn:
                            conn.execute("UPDATE outbox SET processed = 1 WHERE id = ?", (event_id,))
                            conn.commit()
                        print(f"[Outbox Worker] Published event ID {event_id} successfully.")
                    except pika.exceptions.UnroutableError:
                        print(f"[Outbox Worker] Event ID {event_id} was unroutable.")
                    except Exception as ex:
                        print(f"[Outbox Worker] Error publishing Event ID {event_id}: {ex}")
                        raise ex  # reconnect
                
                time.sleep(1)
                
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[Outbox Worker] RabbitMQ connection error: {e}. Retrying in 5 seconds...")
            time.sleep(5)

async def verify_internal_token(authorization: str | None) -> dict:
    if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Session inactive or missing authentication token"
        )
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        try:
            resp = await client.get(f"{IDENTITY_INTERNAL_URL}/api/internal/verify-token", headers={"Authorization": authorization})
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                # Propagate exact unauthorized message
                detail_msg = resp.json().get("detail", "Session inactive or missing authentication token")
                raise HTTPException(status_code=resp.status_code, detail=detail_msg)
            return resp.json()
        except httpx.HTTPError:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
                detail="Auth service unreachable"
            )

    param(

import subprocess
import time
import socket
import json
import uuid
import sys
import httpx
import sqlite3
import pika

AMQP_URL = "amqp://ecommerce:stage4-demo@127.0.0.1:5672/stage4_tessl"
EXCHANGE = "stage4.tessl.exchange"
ROUTING_KEY = "review.approved"

def is_port_listening(port):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        try:
            s.connect(("127.0.0.1", port))
            return True
        except:
            return False

def wait_for_ports(ports, timeout=15):
    start_time = time.time()
    while time.time() - start_time < timeout:
        all_ready = True
        for port in ports:
            if not is_port_listening(port):
                all_ready = False
                break
        if all_ready:
            return True
        time.sleep(0.5)
    return False

def run_distributed_test():
    print("==================================================")
    print("   STAGE 4 DISTRIBUTED STACK VERIFICATION SUITE   ")
    print("==================================================")

    # Clean previous local sqlite databases
    for db_file in ["identity.db", "commerce.db", "reviews.db"]:
        try:
            import os
            if os.path.exists(db_file):
                os.remove(db_file)
                print(f"Removed previous {db_file}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Could not remove {db_file}: {e}")

    # Launch microservices in background
    processes = []
    services_to_start = [
        ("app.identity:app", 18401),
        ("app.commerce:app", 18402),
        ("app.reviews:app", 18403),
        ("app.gateway:app", 18400)
    ]

    for app_module, port in services_to_start:
        cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", app_module, "--port", str(port), "--host", "127.0.0.1"]
        print(f"Starting {app_module} on port {port}...")
        proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, cwd="backend")
        processes.append(proc)

    # Wait for services to start
    ports_list = [18401, 18402, 18403, 18400]
    if not wait_for_ports(ports_list):
        print("ERROR: Upstream services failed to start within timeout. Aborting tests.")
        for p in processes:
            p.terminate()
        sys.exit(1)

    print("\n[SUCCESS] All microservices are active and listening.")

    # HTTP client for verification
    client = httpx.Client()

    try:
        # TEST 1: User Registration & Login (Identity Service)
        print("\n[TEST 1] Registering and logging in standard user via Gateway...")
        reg_payload = {"username": "dist_buyer", "password": "securepass123"}
        reg_resp = client.post("http://127.0.0.1:18400/api/register", json=reg_payload)
        assert reg_resp.status_code == 200, f"Reg failed: {reg_resp.text}"
        token = reg_resp.json()["token"]
        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
        print("Success: dist_buyer registered and authenticated.")

        # TEST 2: Catalog Retrieval & Caching (Commerce Service)
        print("\n[TEST 2] Retrieving product list and verifying cache...")
        resp1 = client.get("http://127.0.0.1:18400/api/products")
        assert resp1.status_code == 200
        products = resp1.json()
        assert len(products) == 5
        print(f"Success: Catalog of {len(products)} products served correctly.")

        # TEST 3: Submit Review (Reviews Service)
        print("\n[TEST 3] Submitting a pending review for product 1...")
        review_comment = f"Amazing split mechanical keyboard - {uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
        review_payload = {
            "rating": 5,
            "comment": review_comment,
            "image_base64": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNk+M9QDwADhgGAWjR9awAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="
        }
        rev_resp = client.post("http://127.0.0.1:18400/api/products/1/reviews", json=review_payload, headers=headers)
        assert rev_resp.status_code == 200, f"Submit failed: {rev_resp.text}"
        review_id = rev_resp.json()["review"]["id"]
        print(f"Success: Review submitted. ID: {review_id}, Status: {rev_resp.json()['review']['status']}")

        # TEST 4: Verification of Pendency (Eventual Consistency Boundary)
        print("\n[TEST 4] Verifying the pending review is NOT visible in public reviews (Commerce)...")
        reviews_resp = client.get("http://127.0.0.1:18400/api/products/1/reviews")
        assert reviews_resp.status_code == 200
        public_comments = [r["comment"] for r in reviews_resp.json()]
        assert review_comment not in public_comments, "Pending review leaked to public projection!"
        print("Success: Pending review remains hidden from public catalog.")

def is_port_listening(port):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        try:
            s.connect(("127.0.0.1", port))
            return True
        except:
            return False

def wait_for_ports(ports, timeout=15):
    start_time = time.time()
    while time.time() - start_time < timeout:
        all_ready = True
        for port in ports:
            if not is_port_listening(port):
                all_ready = False
                break
        if all_ready:
            return True
        time.sleep(0.5)
    return False

## Phase 9: Stage 4 - Reliability and Persistence Fixes
- **TSK-9.1**: Modify `Start-Services.ps1` and `Stop-Services.ps1` to avoid deleting databases on normal start, start background processes with output redirected to logs, run local Vite via node directly to allow clean shutdown, and cleanly kill only owned process trees instead of broad port-killing.
- **TSK-9.2**: Update Commerce and Reviews services to use stable absolute paths for databases and allow environment overrides for DB paths, exchanges, and queues.
- **TSK-9.3**: Implement durable RabbitMQ queues and a concise bounded retry with manual ack in Commerce, and configure Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) topology.
- **TSK-9.4**: Implement versioned envelopes with `version`, `event_id`, `correlation_id`, `type`, `event_type`, `timestamp`, and `payload` in the Reviews Transactional Outbox, and use mandatory routing with confirmations.
- **TSK-9.5**: Support a Terminal-State Contract by publishing a `review.rejected` event when a review is rejected, and having Commerce process it by removing the public review projection and invalidating the cache.
- **TSK-9.6**: Implement and execute the isolated real-RabbitMQ subprocess acceptance test suite `backend/test_reliability_acceptance.py`.

        )

                detail="Session has expired or token is invalid"
            )

        username = row["username"]

            channel.queue_bind(queue=QUEUE, exchange=EXCHANGE, routing_key="review.rejected")
            
            print("[Subscriber Worker] Connected to RabbitMQ with DLQ and terminal-state routing.")
            
            def callback(ch, method, properties, body):
                max_retries = 3
                for attempt in range(1, max_retries + 1):
                    try:
                        event = json.loads(body.decode('utf-8'))
                        event_type = event.get("event_type") or event.get("type")
                        payload = event["payload"]

                            # Invalidate reviews cache

                            print(f"[Subscriber Worker] Invalidated cache for key 'reviews:{product_id}'")
                            
                        elif event_type == "review.rejected":
                            review_id = payload["review_id"]
                            product_id = payload["product_id"]
                            
                            print(f"[Subscriber Worker] (Attempt {attempt}/{max_retries}) Received rejected review event ID {review_id} for product {product_id}")
                            
                            # Idempotently delete from public_reviews table
                            with get_db() as conn:
                                conn.execute("DELETE FROM public_reviews WHERE id = ?", (review_id,))
                                conn.commit()
                                print(f"[Subscriber Worker] Deleted review ID {review_id} from public projection.")
                            
                            # Invalidate reviews cache
                            response_cache.invalidate(f"reviews:{product_id}")
                            print(f"[Subscriber Worker] Invalidated cache for key 'reviews:{product_id}'")
                        
                        else:
                            # Unexpected event type, throw to trigger retries/DLQ
                            raise ValueError(f"Unknown event type: {event_type}")

                        # Succeeded! Manual ack and return from loop
                        ch.basic_ack(delivery_tag=method.delivery_tag)
                        return

            detail="Session inactive or missing authentication token"

    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:

                detail_msg = resp.json().get("detail", "Session inactive or missing authentication token")

        except httpx.HTTPError:

def outbox_publisher_loop():
    print("[Outbox Worker] Thread started.")
    while True:
        try:
            params = pika.URLParameters(AMQP_URL)
            connection = pika.BlockingConnection(params)
            channel = connection.channel()
            # Enable publisher confirmations
            channel.confirm_delivery()
            
            # 1. Declare exchange
            channel.exchange_declare(exchange=EXCHANGE, exchange_type='direct', durable=True)
            
            # 2. Declare and bind the commerce queue to guarantee event routing even if commerce starts late
            channel.queue_declare(queue=COMMERCE_QUEUE, durable=True)
            channel.queue_bind(queue=COMMERCE_QUEUE, exchange=EXCHANGE, routing_key="review.approved")
            channel.queue_bind(queue=COMMERCE_QUEUE, exchange=EXCHANGE, routing_key="review.rejected")
            
            print("[Outbox Worker] Connected to RabbitMQ with queue bind guarantees.")

                if not rows:
                    time.sleep(1)
                    continue
                
                for row in rows:
                    event_id = row["id"]
                    event_type = row["event_type"]
                    payload_str = row["payload"]
                    
                    try:
                        # Publish with mandatory=True and use event_type as routing key
                        channel.basic_publish(

    if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Session inactive or missing authentication token"
        )
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        try:
            resp = await client.get(f"{IDENTITY_INTERNAL_URL}/api/internal/verify-token", headers={"Authorization": authorization})
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                # Propagate exact unauthorized message
                detail_msg = resp.json().get("detail", "Session inactive or missing authentication token")

            return resp.json()
        except httpx.HTTPError:

            )
        elif payload.status == "rejected":
            event_payload = {
                "version": "1.0",
                "event_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                "correlation_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                "type": "review.rejected",
                "event_type": "review.rejected",
                "timestamp": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
                "payload": {
                    "review_id": id,
                    "product_id": row["product_id"]
                }
            }
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO outbox (event_type, payload, processed, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                ("review.rejected", json.dumps(event_payload), 0, datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
            )

        conn.commit()

        # Fetch updated review details
        cur.execute("SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE id = ?", (id,))
        updated_review = dict(cur.fetchone())

    return {
        "message": f"Review status updated to '{payload.status}' successfully.",
        "review": updated_review
    }

# Start-Services.ps1
# PowerShell script to launch and verify all Stage 4 microservices locally

Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Starting E-Commerce Microservices (Stage 4)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Create logs directory for hidden/logged processes
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "logs" | Out-Null

# Define stable absolute database paths for the normal startup
$env:IDENTITY_DB_FILE = Resolve-Path "backend\identity.db" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $env:IDENTITY_DB_FILE) {
    $env:IDENTITY_DB_FILE = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath("backend\identity.db")
}
$env:COMMERCE_DB_FILE = Resolve-Path "backend\commerce.db" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $env:COMMERCE_DB_FILE) {
    $env:COMMERCE_DB_FILE = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath("backend\commerce.db")
}
$env:REVIEWS_DB_FILE = Resolve-Path "backend\reviews.db" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $env:REVIEWS_DB_FILE) {
    $env:REVIEWS_DB_FILE = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath("backend\reviews.db")
}

# 1. Start Identity Service (Port 18401)
$identityProc = Start-Process -FilePath "uvicorn" -ArgumentList "app.identity:app --port 18401 --host 127.0.0.1" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput "logs\identity.out.log" -RedirectStandardError "logs\identity.err.log"
$identityPid = $identityProc.Id
Write-Host "Launched Identity Service (PID: $identityPid)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# 2. Start Commerce Service (Port 18402)
$commerceProc = Start-Process -FilePath "uvicorn" -ArgumentList "app.commerce:app --port 18402 --host 127.0.0.1" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput "logs\commerce.out.log" -RedirectStandardError "logs\commerce.err.log"
$commercePid = $commerceProc.Id
Write-Host "Launched Commerce Service (PID: $commercePid)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# 3. Start Reviews Service (Port 18403)
$reviewsProc = Start-Process -FilePath "uvicorn" -ArgumentList "app.reviews:app --port 18403 --host 127.0.0.1" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput "logs\reviews.out.log" -RedirectStandardError "logs\reviews.err.log"
$reviewsPid = $reviewsProc.Id
Write-Host "Launched Reviews Service (PID: $reviewsPid)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# 4. Start Gateway Service (Port 18400)
$gatewayProc = Start-Process -FilePath "uvicorn" -ArgumentList "app.gateway:app --port 18400 --host 127.0.0.1" -WorkingDirectory "backend" -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput "logs\gateway.out.log" -RedirectStandardError "logs\gateway.err.log"
$gatewayPid = $gatewayProc.Id
Write-Host "Launched Gateway Service (PID: $gatewayPid)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# 5. Start Frontend Service via Node + local Vite directly (Port 18500)
$frontendProc = Start-Process -FilePath "node" -ArgumentList "node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --port 18500 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1" -WorkingDirectory "frontend" -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput "logs\frontend.out.log" -RedirectStandardError "logs\frontend.err.log"
$frontendPid = $frontendProc.Id
Write-Host "Launched Frontend Service (PID: $frontendPid)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# Save PIDs to services-pids.json for clean stop management
$pids = @{
    identity = $identityPid
    commerce = $commercePid
    reviews = $reviewsPid
    gateway = $gatewayPid
    frontend = $frontendPid
} | ConvertTo-Json

$pids | Out-File -FilePath "services-pids.json" -Encoding utf8

# Deterministic Readiness Checks
Write-Host "Running readiness port checks..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$ports = @(18401, 18402, 18403, 18400, 18500)
$allReady = $true

foreach ($port in $ports) {
    $ready = $false
    for ($i = 1; $i -le 30; $i++) {
        try {
            $conn = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient("127.0.0.1", $port)
            $conn.Close()
            $ready = $true
            break
        } catch {
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
        }
    }
    if ($ready) {
        Write-Host "Port $port is active and listening." -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
        Write-Host "Port $port failed to start within timeout limit." -ForegroundColor Red
        $allReady = $false
    }
}

if ($allReady) {
    Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "All Stage 4 microservices launched successfully!" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Warning: Some microservices failed to respond." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
}

if (-not $env:REVIEWS_DB_FILE) {

}

# 1. Start Identity Service (Port 18401)

$gatewayPid = $gatewayProc.Id
Write-Host "Launched Gateway Service (PID: $gatewayPid)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# 5. Start Frontend Service via Node + local Vite directly (Port 18500)
$frontendProc = Start-Process -FilePath "node" -ArgumentList "node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --port 18500 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1" -WorkingDirectory "frontend" -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput "logs\frontend.out.log" -RedirectStandardError "logs\frontend.err.log"
$frontendPid = $frontendProc.Id
Write-Host "Launched Frontend Service (PID: $frontendPid)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# Save PIDs to services-pids.json for clean stop management
$pids = @{
    identity = $identityPid
    commerce = $commercePid
    reviews = $reviewsPid
    gateway = $gatewayPid
    frontend = $frontendPid
} | ConvertTo-Json

$pids | Out-File -FilePath "services-pids.json" -Encoding utf8

# Deterministic Readiness Checks
Write-Host "Running readiness port checks..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
$ports = @(18401, 18402, 18403, 18400, 18500)
$allReady = $true

foreach ($port in $ports) {
    $ready = $false
    for ($i = 1; $i -le 30; $i++) {
        try {
            $conn = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient("127.0.0.1", $port)
            $conn.Close()
            $ready = $true
            break
        } catch {
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
        }
    }
    if ($ready) {
        Write-Host "Port $port is active and listening." -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
        Write-Host "Port $port failed to start within timeout limit." -ForegroundColor Red
        $allReady = $false
    }
}

if ($allReady) {
    Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "All Stage 4 microservices launched successfully!" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Warning: Some microservices failed to respond." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
}

import subprocess
import time
import socket
import json
import uuid
import sys
import os
import sqlite3
import pika
import httpx

# Real RabbitMQ configuration from stage4-runtime.json
AMQP_URL = "amqp://ecommerce:stage4-demo@127.0.0.1:5672/stage4_tessl"

def is_port_listening(port):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        try:
            s.connect(("127.0.0.1", port))
            return True
        except:
            return False

def wait_for_ports(ports, timeout=15):
    start_time = time.time()
    while time.time() - start_time < timeout:
        all_ready = True
        for port in ports:
            if not is_port_listening(port):
                all_ready = False
                break
        if all_ready:
            return True
        time.sleep(0.5)
    return False

def terminate_process_tree(proc):
    """Cleanly terminate a subprocess using OS signals."""
    if proc:
        try:
            proc.terminate()
            proc.wait(timeout=3)
        except Exception:
            try:
                proc.kill()
            except Exception:
                pass

def run_acceptance_suite():
    print("==================================================")
    print("   STAGE 4 RELIABILITY & PERSISTENCE ACCEPTANCE   ")
    print("==================================================")

    # 0. Generate unique names for isolation
    unique_id = str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]
    AMQP_EXCHANGE = f"test_exchange_{unique_id}"
    AMQP_QUEUE = f"test_queue_{unique_id}"
    AMQP_ROUTING_KEY = f"test_routing_{unique_id}"

    # Temp DB Paths (absolute paths)
    IDENTITY_DB_FILE = os.path.abspath(f"backend/test_identity_{unique_id}.db")
    COMMERCE_DB_FILE = os.path.abspath(f"backend/test_commerce_{unique_id}.db")
    REVIEWS_DB_FILE = os.path.abspath(f"backend/test_reviews_{unique_id}.db")

    print(f"Isolated Exchange: {AMQP_EXCHANGE}")
    print(f"Isolated Queue: {AMQP_QUEUE}")
    print(f"Isolated Identity DB: {IDENTITY_DB_FILE}")
    print(f"Isolated Commerce DB: {COMMERCE_DB_FILE}")
    print(f"Isolated Reviews DB: {REVIEWS_DB_FILE}")

    # Remove any pre-existing temp databases
    for db in [IDENTITY_DB_FILE, COMMERCE_DB_FILE, REVIEWS_DB_FILE]:
        if os.path.exists(db):
            os.remove(db)

    # Dictionary representing env vars for the services
    common_env = os.environ.copy()
    common_env["IDENTITY_DB_FILE"] = IDENTITY_DB_FILE
    common_env["COMMERCE_DB_FILE"] = COMMERCE_DB_FILE
    common_env["REVIEWS_DB_FILE"] = REVIEWS_DB_FILE
    common_env["AMQP_EXCHANGE"] = AMQP_EXCHANGE
    common_env["AMQP_QUEUE"] = AMQP_QUEUE
    common_env["AMQP_ROUTING_KEY"] = AMQP_ROUTING_KEY

    # Ports
    ports = {
        "identity": 18401,
        "commerce": 18402,
        "reviews": 18403,
        "gateway": 18400
    }

    # Helper to start a microservice
    def start_service(name, port, extra_env=None):
        cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", f"app.{name}:app", "--port", str(port), "--host", "127.0.0.1"]
        env = common_env.copy()
        if extra_env:
            env.update(extra_env)
        print(f"Starting {name} on port {port}...")
        return subprocess.Popen(cmd, cwd="backend", env=env)

    # Start all services initially
    procs = {}
    procs["identity"] = start_service("identity", ports["identity"])
    procs["commerce"] = start_service("commerce", ports["commerce"])
    procs["reviews"] = start_service("reviews", ports["reviews"])
    procs["gateway"] = start_service("gateway", ports["gateway"])

    # Wait for all to be listening
    if not wait_for_ports(list(ports.values())):
        print("ERROR: Services failed to start.")
        for p in procs.values():
            terminate_process_tree(p)
        sys.exit(1)

    print("[SUCCESS] All services started and listening.")
    client = httpx.Client()

    try:
        # Prerequisites: Register & Login standard user, and moderator
        print("\n--- Registering standard user and moderator ---")
        reg_resp = client.post(f"http://127.0.0.1:{ports['gateway']}/api/register", json={"username": "acc_buyer", "password": "buyerpass123"})
        assert reg_resp.status_code == 200, reg_resp.text
        buyer_token = reg_resp.json()["token"]
        buyer_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {buyer_token}"}

        mod_login = client.post(f"http://127.0.0.1:{ports['gateway']}/api/login", json={"username": "moderator", "password": "moderator"})
        assert mod_login.status_code == 200
        mod_token = mod_login.json()["token"]
        mod_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {mod_token}"}
        print("User credentials established successfully.")

        # =====================================================================
        # TEST CASE 1: Stop Commerce only, Approve review while offline, Recovery
        # =====================================================================
        print("\n--- [TEST CASE 1] Stop Commerce only, Approve review while offline, Recovery ---")
        
        # Submit a review for product 1
        review_comment_1 = f"Excellent quality mechanical keycaps - {uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
        rev_payload = {
            "rating": 5,
            "comment": review_comment_1,
            "image_base64": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNk+M9QDwADhgGAWjR9awAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="
        }
        submit_resp = client.post(f"http://127.0.0.1:{ports['gateway']}/api/products/1/reviews", json=rev_payload, headers=buyer_headers)
        assert submit_resp.status_code == 200, submit_resp.text
        review_id_1 = submit_resp.json()["review"]["id"]
        print(f"Review 1 submitted (ID: {review_id_1}) and is pending.")

        # Confirm review is not public yet
        check_pub = client.get(f"http://127.0.0.1:{ports['gateway']}/api/products/1/reviews")
        assert review_comment_1 not in [r["comment"] for r in check_pub.json()]
        print("Confirmed pending review is hidden.")

        # Stop Commerce Service ONLY
        print("Stopping Commerce microservice process tree...")
        terminate_process_tree(procs["commerce"])
        del procs["commerce"]
        time.sleep(1)
        assert not is_port_listening(ports["commerce"]), "Commerce port should be closed!"
        print("Commerce is offline.")

        # Approve review via Gateway while Commerce is offline
        approve_resp = client.post(f"http://127.0.0.1:{ports['gateway']}/api/moderation/reviews/{review_id_1}/status", json={"status": "approved"}, headers=mod_headers)
        assert approve_resp.status_code == 200
        print("Moderator approved review while Commerce was offline.")

        # Verify Outbox row is marked processed = 1 inside reviews.db (meaning reviews successfully published it)
        time.sleep(2)  # Give publisher a moment to publish
        conn = sqlite3.connect(REVIEWS_DB_FILE)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT processed, payload FROM outbox ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1")
        row = cur.fetchone()
        conn.close()
        assert row is not None, "No outbox row staged!"
        assert row["processed"] == 1, "Outbox should have marked event processed!"
        print("Verified that Reviews successfully published the event to RabbitMQ.")

        # Inspect RabbitMQ message count (it should be queued in the durable queue)
        params = pika.URLParameters(AMQP_URL)
        mq_conn = pika.BlockingConnection(params)
        mq_channel = mq_conn.channel()
        q_declare = mq_channel.queue_declare(queue=AMQP_QUEUE, durable=True)
        msg_count = q_declare.method.message_count
        print(f"RabbitMQ Queue {AMQP_QUEUE} contains {msg_count} queued message(s).")
        mq_conn.close()
        assert msg_count >= 1, "Expected at least 1 message queued in RabbitMQ!"

        # Restart Commerce Service
        print("Restarting Commerce service...")
        procs["commerce"] = start_service("commerce", ports["commerce"])
        assert wait_for_ports([ports["commerce"]]), "Commerce failed to start on recovery!"
        print("Commerce restored.")

        # Wait a moment for the subscriber to process the queued event (Eventual Consistency Recovery)
        print("Waiting for eventual consistency recovery...")
        recovered = False
        for _ in range(10):
            time.sleep(0.5)
            check_pub = client.get(f"http://127.0.0.1:{ports['gateway']}/api/products/1/reviews")
            assert check_pub.status_code == 200
            public_comments = [r["comment"] for r in check_pub.json()]
            if review_comment_1 in public_comments:
                recovered = True
                break

        assert recovered, "Recovery failed: Approved review did not propagate to public projection!"
        print("[SUCCESS] Test Case 1 Passed: Offline recovery succeeded perfectly.")

        # =====================================================================
        # TEST CASE 2: Idempotency (Republish exact event ID)
        # =====================================================================
        print("\n--- [TEST CASE 2] Idempotency (Duplicate message ingestion) ---")
        # Extract the exact payload we processed
        event_payload = json.loads(row["payload"])
        
        # Publish it again directly to AMQP
        print("Directly republishing identical event payload to exchange...")
        mq_conn = pika.BlockingConnection(params)
        mq_channel = mq_conn.channel()
        mq_channel.basic_publish(
            exchange=AMQP_EXCHANGE,
            routing_key="review.approved",
            body=json.dumps(event_payload),
            properties=pika.BasicProperties(delivery_mode=2)
        )
        mq_conn.close()

        # Wait
        time.sleep(1)

        # Assert no duplicate review in public_reviews database
        comm_conn = sqlite3.connect(COMMERCE_DB_FILE)
        cur = comm_conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public_reviews WHERE id = ?", (review_id_1,))
        count = cur.fetchone()[0]
        comm_conn.close()
        assert count == 1, f"Idempotency violated! Found {count} rows instead of 1."
        print("[SUCCESS] Test Case 2 Passed: Duplicate message discarded safely, idempotence retained.")

        # =====================================================================
        # TEST CASE 3: Unavailable AMQP Endpoint outbox durability & restart survival
        # =====================================================================
        print("\n--- [TEST CASE 3] Outbox durability with unavailable AMQP & Service Restart ---")
        
        # Submit another review
        review_comment_2 = f"Stunning water bottle - {uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
        submit_resp_2 = client.post(f"http://127.0.0.1:{ports['gateway']}/api/products/2/reviews", json={"rating": 5, "comment": review_comment_2}, headers=buyer_headers)
        assert submit_resp_2.status_code == 200
        review_id_2 = submit_resp_2.json()["review"]["id"]
        print(f"Review 2 submitted (ID: {review_id_2}).")

        # Stop Reviews Service
        print("Stopping Reviews service to restart with unavailable AMQP URL...")
        terminate_process_tree(procs["reviews"])
        del procs["reviews"]
        time.sleep(1)

        # Restart Reviews Service with unreachable AMQP endpoint
        bad_amqp_env = {"AMQP_URL": "amqp://ecommerce:stage4-demo@127.0.0.1:9999/stage4_tessl"} # bad port
        procs["reviews"] = start_service("reviews", ports["reviews"], extra_env=bad_amqp_env)
        assert wait_for_ports([ports["reviews"]]), "Reviews failed to restart!"
        print("Reviews restarted with an unreachable AMQP broker.")

        # Moderator approves the review via Gateway
        approve_resp_2 = client.post(f"http://127.0.0.1:{ports['gateway']}/api/moderation/reviews/{review_id_2}/status", json={"status": "approved"}, headers=mod_headers)
        assert approve_resp_2.status_code == 200
        print("Moderator approved review while Reviews was pointing to unreachable AMQP broker.")

        # Verify that in reviews DB, outbox row is staged but remains unprocessed (processed = 0)
        time.sleep(2)
        conn = sqlite3.connect(REVIEWS_DB_FILE)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT processed FROM outbox ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1")
        row2 = cur.fetchone()
        conn.close()
        assert row2 is not None
        assert row2["processed"] == 0, "Event should NOT be processed when AMQP is unreachable!"
        print("Confirmed outbox event remains pending (processed = 0).")

        # Simulate service restart: Stop Reviews and restart still with bad AMQP to prove survival
        print("Simulating service restart: Stopping Reviews service...")
        terminate_process_tree(procs["reviews"])
        del procs["reviews"]
        time.sleep(1)

        print("Restarting Reviews service with bad AMQP to prove survival...")
        procs["reviews"] = start_service("reviews", ports["reviews"], extra_env=bad_amqp_env)
        assert wait_for_ports([ports["reviews"]]), "Reviews failed to restart!"

        # Verify event still exists and is unprocessed (durability!)
        conn = sqlite3.connect(REVIEWS_DB_FILE)
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT processed FROM outbox WHERE id = (SELECT max(id) FROM outbox)")
        row2_check = cur.fetchone()
        conn.close()
        assert row2_check is not None

import subprocess
import time
import socket
import json
import uuid
import sys
import os
import sqlite3
import pika
import httpx

# Real RabbitMQ configuration from stage4-runtime.json
AMQP_URL = "amqp://ecommerce:stage4-demo@127.0.0.1:5672/stage4_tessl"

def is_port_listening(port):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        try:
            s.connect(("127.0.0.1", port))
            return True
        except:
            return False

def wait_for_ports(ports, timeout=15):
    start_time = time.time()
    while time.time() - start_time < timeout:
        all_ready = True
        for port in ports:
            if not is_port_listening(port):
                all_ready = False
                break
        if all_ready:
            return True
        time.sleep(0.5)
    return False

def terminate_process_tree(proc):
    """Cleanly terminate a subprocess using OS signals."""
    if proc:
        try:
            proc.terminate()
            proc.wait(timeout=3)
        except Exception:
            try:
                proc.kill()
            except Exception:
                pass

                except:
                    pass

        # Run Start-Services.ps1
        print("Running Start-Services.ps1...")
        p_start = subprocess.Popen(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-Command", ".\\Start-Services.ps1"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
        stdout, stderr = p_start.communicate()
        print("Start-Services Output:")
        print(stdout)
        assert p_start.returncode == 0, f"Start-Services failed! {stderr}"

        # Confirm services started
        assert wait_for_ports([18400, 18401, 18402, 18403, 18500]), "Normal launcher ports failed to start!"

        # Register a unique user under this normal stack
        print("Registering a user 'persist_user' in the normal running stack...")
        reg_normal = client.post("http://127.0.0.1:18400/api/register", json={"username": "persist_user", "password": "persistpass123"})
        assert reg_normal.status_code == 200, reg_normal.text
        print("User registered successfully in normal running stack.")

        # Run Stop-Services.ps1
        print("Running Stop-Services.ps1...")
        p_stop = subprocess.Popen(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-Command", ".\\Stop-Services.ps1"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
        stdout_stop, stderr_stop = p_stop.communicate()
        print("Stop-Services Output:")
        print(stdout_stop)
        assert p_stop.returncode == 0, f"Stop-Services failed! {stderr_stop}"
        time.sleep(2)

        # Confirm services stopped and ports closed
        for port in [18400, 18401, 18402, 18403, 18500]:
            assert not is_port_listening(port), f"Port {port} should have stopped!"
        print("All microservices are verified offline.")

        # Run Start-Services.ps1 again
        print("Running Start-Services.ps1 again...")
        p_start_2 = subprocess.Popen(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-Command", ".\\Start-Services.ps1"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
        stdout_2, stderr_2 = p_start_2.communicate()
        assert p_start_2.returncode == 0, f"Start-Services 2 failed! {stderr_2}"
        
        assert wait_for_ports([18400, 18401, 18402, 18403, 18500]), "Services failed to start on second launch!"

        # Attempt to login 'persist_user'. If DBs are preserved, login should succeed!
        print("Attempting login of 'persist_user' to prove store persistence...")
        login_normal = client.post("http://127.0.0.1:18400/api/login", json={"username": "persist_user", "password": "persistpass123"})
        
        # Stop services first so we don't leave them running before assertion check
        print("Stopping standard microservices stack...")
        p_stop_final = subprocess.Popen(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-Command", ".\\Stop-Services.ps1"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
        p_stop_final.communicate()
        
        assert login_normal.status_code == 200, f"Store was destroyed! Login failed: {login_normal.text}"
        print("[SUCCESS] Test Case 6 Passed: Stores correctly preserved across start/stop cycles!")

        print("\n==================================================")
        print("  ALL RELIABILITY ACCEPTANCE TESTS PASSED PERFECTLY!")
        print("==================================================")

    except Exception as ex:
        print(f"\n[FAILURE] Acceptance suite encountered error: {ex}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        # Clean shutdown of all running subprocesses
        for p in procs.values():
            terminate_process_tree(p)
        # Attempt standard stop
        p_stop = subprocess.Popen(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-Command", ".\\Stop-Services.ps1"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
        p_stop.communicate()
        sys.exit(1)
    finally:
        # Clean temp DB files
        print("\nCleaning up temporary database files...")
        for db in [IDENTITY_DB_FILE, COMMERCE_DB_FILE, REVIEWS_DB_FILE]:
            if os.path.exists(db):
                try:
                    os.remove(db)
                    print(f"Deleted {db}")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"Warning: Could not delete {db}: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_acceptance_suite()

def outbox_publisher_loop():
    print("[Outbox Worker] Thread started.")
    while True:
        try:
            params = pika.URLParameters(AMQP_URL)
            connection = pika.BlockingConnection(params)
            channel = connection.channel()
            # Enable publisher confirmations
            channel.confirm_delivery()
            
            # 1. Declare exchange
            channel.exchange_declare(exchange=EXCHANGE, exchange_type='direct', durable=True)
            
            # 2. Declare and bind the commerce queue to guarantee event routing even if commerce starts late.
            # Configure exact matching Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) topology arguments.
            dlx_name = EXCHANGE + ".dlx"
            dlq_name = COMMERCE_QUEUE + ".dlq"
            channel.exchange_declare(exchange=dlx_name, exchange_type='direct', durable=True)
            channel.queue_declare(queue=dlq_name, durable=True)
            channel.queue_bind(queue=dlq_name, exchange=dlx_name, routing_key="dlq")

            queue_args = {
                "x-dead-letter-exchange": dlx_name,
                "x-dead-letter-routing-key": "dlq"
            }
            channel.queue_declare(queue=COMMERCE_QUEUE, durable=True, arguments=queue_args)
            channel.queue_bind(queue=COMMERCE_QUEUE, exchange=EXCHANGE, routing_key="review.approved")
            channel.queue_bind(queue=COMMERCE_QUEUE, exchange=EXCHANGE, routing_key="review.rejected")
            
            print("[Outbox Worker] Connected to RabbitMQ with queue bind guarantees.")
            
            while True:
                with get_db() as conn:
                    cur = conn.cursor()
                    cur.execute("SELECT id, event_type, payload FROM outbox WHERE processed = 0 ORDER BY id ASC")
                    rows = cur.fetchall()
                
                if not rows:
                    time.sleep(1)
                    continue
                
                for row in rows:
                    event_id = row["id"]
                    event_type = row["event_type"]
                    payload_str = row["payload"]
                    
                    try:
                        # Publish with mandatory=True and use event_type as routing key
                        channel.basic_publish(
                            exchange=EXCHANGE,
                            routing_key=event_type,
                            body=payload_str,
                            mandatory=True,
                            properties=pika.BasicProperties(
                                delivery_mode=2,  # persistent message
                                content_type='application/json'
                            )
                        )
                        with get_db() as conn:
                            conn.execute("UPDATE outbox SET processed = 1 WHERE id = ?", (event_id,))
                            conn.commit()
                        print(f"[Outbox Worker] Published event ID {event_id} of type {event_type} successfully.")
                    except pika.exceptions.UnroutableError:
                        print(f"[Outbox Worker] Event ID {event_id} was unroutable. Retaining in outbox.")
                        time.sleep(1)
                    except Exception as ex:

                        raise ex  # reconnect

async def verify_internal_token(authorization: str | None) -> dict:
    if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Session inactive or missing authentication token"
        )
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        try:
            resp = await client.get(f"{IDENTITY_INTERNAL_URL}/api/internal/verify-token", headers={"Authorization": authorization})
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                # Propagate exact unauthorized message
                detail_msg = resp.json().get("detail", "Session inactive or missing authentication token")
                raise HTTPException(status_code=resp.status_code, detail=detail_msg)
            return resp.json()
        except httpx.HTTPError:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
                detail="Auth service unreachable"
            )

async def create_product_review(id: int, payload: ReviewCreateSchema, authorization: str | None = Header(None)):
    user_info = await verify_internal_token(authorization)
    username = user_info["username"]

    # Image validation (size and format check)
    if payload.image_base64:
        # Simple local file check: check size
        # data:image/png;base64,iVBORw...
        if len(payload.image_base64) > 2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1.33: # Approx 2MB in base64
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                detail="Attached image exceeds the maximum size limit of 2MB."
            )
        if not payload.image_base64.startswith("data:image/"):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                detail="Unsupported image format. Only JPEG, PNG, and GIF are allowed."
            )

    created_at = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    with get_db() as conn:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO reviews (product_id, rating, comment, image_base64, status, username, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (id, payload.rating, payload.comment, payload.image_base64, "pending", username, created_at)
        )
        new_review_id = cur.lastrowid
        conn.commit()

        # Fetch the newly created review to return
        cur.execute("SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE id = ?", (new_review_id,))
        new_review = dict(cur.fetchone())

    return {

    }

def outbox_publisher_loop():
    print("[Outbox Worker] Thread started.")
    while True:
        try:
            params = pika.URLParameters(AMQP_URL)
            connection = pika.BlockingConnection(params)
            channel = connection.channel()
            # Enable publisher confirmations
            channel.confirm_delivery()
            
            # 1. Declare exchange
            channel.exchange_declare(exchange=EXCHANGE, exchange_type='direct', durable=True)
            
            # 2. Declare and bind the commerce queue to guarantee event routing even if commerce starts late.
            # Configure exact matching Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) topology arguments.
            dlx_name = EXCHANGE + ".dlx"
            dlq_name = COMMERCE_QUEUE + ".dlq"
            channel.exchange_declare(exchange=dlx_name, exchange_type='direct', durable=True)
            channel.queue_declare(queue=dlq_name, durable=True)
            channel.queue_bind(queue=dlq_name, exchange=dlx_name, routing_key="dlq")

            queue_args = {
                "x-dead-letter-exchange": dlx_name,
                "x-dead-letter-routing-key": "dlq"
            }
            channel.queue_declare(queue=COMMERCE_QUEUE, durable=True, arguments=queue_args)
            channel.queue_bind(queue=COMMERCE_QUEUE, exchange=EXCHANGE, routing_key="review.approved")
            channel.queue_bind(queue=COMMERCE_QUEUE, exchange=EXCHANGE, routing_key="review.rejected")
            
            print("[Outbox Worker] Connected to RabbitMQ with queue bind guarantees.")
            
            while True:
                with get_db() as conn:
                    cur = conn.cursor()
                    cur.execute("SELECT id, event_type, payload FROM outbox WHERE processed = 0 ORDER BY id ASC")
                    rows = cur.fetchall()
                
                if not rows:
                    time.sleep(1)
                    continue
                
                for row in rows:
                    event_id = row["id"]
                    event_type = row["event_type"]
                    payload_str = row["payload"]
                    
                    try:
                        # Publish with mandatory=True and use event_type as routing key
                        channel.basic_publish(
                            exchange=EXCHANGE,
                            routing_key=event_type,
                            body=payload_str,
                            mandatory=True,
                            properties=pika.BasicProperties(
                                delivery_mode=2,  # persistent message
                                content_type='application/json'
                            )
                        )
                        with get_db() as conn:
                            conn.execute("UPDATE outbox SET processed = 1 WHERE id = ?", (event_id,))
                            conn.commit()
                        print(f"[Outbox Worker] Published event ID {event_id} of type {event_type} successfully.")
                    except pika.exceptions.UnroutableError:
                        print(f"[Outbox Worker] Event ID {event_id} was unroutable. Retaining in outbox.")
                        time.sleep(1)
                    except Exception as ex:
                        print(f"[Outbox Worker] Error publishing Event ID {event_id}: {ex}")
                        raise ex  # reconnect
                
                time.sleep(1)
                
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[Outbox Worker] RabbitMQ connection error: {e}. Retrying in 5 seconds...")
            time.sleep(5)

@app.on_event("startup")
def startup_event():
    # 1. Initialize SQLite Database
    with get_db() as conn:
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reviews (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                product_id INTEGER,
                rating INTEGER,
                comment TEXT,
                image_base64 TEXT,
                status TEXT,
                username TEXT,
                created_at TEXT
            )
        """)
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbox (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                event_type TEXT,
                payload TEXT,
                processed INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                created_at TEXT
            )
        """)
        conn.commit()

    # 2. Seed default reviews
    with get_db() as conn:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews")
        if cur.fetchone()[0] == 0:
            for r in REVIEWS_SEED:
                conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO reviews (id, product_id, rating, comment, image_base64, status, username, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (r["id"], r["product_id"], r["rating"], r["comment"], r["image_base64"], r["status"], r["username"], r["created_at"])
                )
            conn.commit()

    # 3. Start background publisher thread
    worker_thread = threading.Thread(target=outbox_publisher_loop, daemon=True)
    worker_thread.start()

async def verify_internal_token(authorization: str | None) -> dict:
    if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Session inactive or missing authentication token"
        )
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        try:
            resp = await client.get(f"{IDENTITY_INTERNAL_URL}/api/internal/verify-token", headers={"Authorization": authorization})
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                # Propagate exact unauthorized message
                detail_msg = resp.json().get("detail", "Session inactive or missing authentication token")
                raise HTTPException(status_code=resp.status_code, detail=detail_msg)
            return resp.json()
        except httpx.HTTPError:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
                detail="Auth service unreachable"
            )

@app.post("/api/products/{id}/reviews")
async def create_product_review(id: int, payload: ReviewCreateSchema, authorization: str | None = Header(None)):
    user_info = await verify_internal_token(authorization)
    username = user_info["username"]

    # Image validation (size and format check)
    if payload.image_base64:
        # Simple local file check: check size
        # data:image/png;base64,iVBORw...
        if len(payload.image_base64) > 2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1.33: # Approx 2MB in base64
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                detail="Attached image exceeds the maximum size limit of 2MB."
            )
        if not payload.image_base64.startswith("data:image/"):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                detail="Unsupported image format. Only JPEG, PNG, and GIF are allowed."
            )

    created_at = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    with get_db() as conn:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO reviews (product_id, rating, comment, image_base64, status, username, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (id, payload.rating, payload.comment, payload.image_base64, "pending", username, created_at)
        )
        new_review_id = cur.lastrowid
        conn.commit()

        # Fetch the newly created review to return
        cur.execute("SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE id = ?", (new_review_id,))
        new_review = dict(cur.fetchone())

    return {
        "message": "Review submitted successfully and is currently pending moderation.",
        "review": new_review
    }

@app.get("/api/moderation/reviews")
async def get_all_reviews_for_moderation(authorization: str | None = Header(None)):
    user_info = await verify_internal_token(authorization)
    if not user_info.get("is_moderator", False):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Access denied. Only the 'moderator' user can access moderation APIs."
        )

    with get_db() as conn:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT * FROM reviews ORDER BY id ASC")
        rows = cur.fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

@app.post("/api/moderation/reviews/{id}/status")
async def update_review_status(id: int, payload: ReviewStatusUpdateSchema, authorization: str | None = Header(None)):
    user_info = await verify_internal_token(authorization)
    if not user_info.get("is_moderator", False):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Access denied. Only the 'moderator' user can access moderation APIs."
        )

    with get_db() as conn:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE id = ?", (id,))
        row = cur.fetchone()
        if not row:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=f"Review with ID {id} was not found"
            )
        
        # 1. Update review status
        conn.execute("UPDATE reviews SET status = ? WHERE id = ?", (payload.status, id))
        
        # 2. Transactionally append to outbox if approved or rejected
        if payload.status == "approved":
            event_payload = {
                "version": "1.0",
                "event_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                "correlation_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                "type": "review.approved",
                "event_type": "review.approved",
                "timestamp": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
                "payload": {
                    "review_id": id,
                    "product_id": row["product_id"],
                    "rating": row["rating"],
                    "comment": row["comment"],
                    "image_base64": row["image_base64"],
                    "username": row["username"],
                    "created_at": row["created_at"]
                }
            }
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO outbox (event_type, payload, processed, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                ("review.approved", json.dumps(event_payload), 0, datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
            )
        elif payload.status == "rejected":
            event_payload = {
                "version": "1.0",
                "event_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                "correlation_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                "type": "review.rejected",
                "event_type": "review.rejected",
                "timestamp": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
                "payload": {
                    "review_id": id,
                    "product_id": row["product_id"]
                }
            }
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO outbox (event_type, payload, processed, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                ("review.rejected", json.dumps(event_payload), 0, datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
            )

        conn.commit()

        # Fetch updated review details
        cur.execute("SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE id = ?", (id,))
        updated_review = dict(cur.fetchone())

    return {
        "message": f"Review status updated to '{payload.status}' successfully.",
        "review": updated_review

def is_port_listening(port):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        try:
            s.connect(("127.0.0.1", port))
            return True
        except:
            return False

def wait_for_ports(ports, timeout=15):
    start_time = time.time()
    while time.time() - start_time < timeout:
        all_ready = True
        for port in ports:
            if not is_port_listening(port):
                all_ready = False
                break
        if all_ready:
            return True
        time.sleep(0.5)
    return False

def terminate_process_tree(proc):
    """Cleanly terminate a subprocess using OS signals."""
    if proc:
        try:
            proc.terminate()
            proc.wait(timeout=3)
        except Exception:
            try:
                proc.kill()
            except Exception:

        # Run Start-Services.ps1

        print("[SUCCESS] Test Case 6 Passed: Stores correctly preserved across start/stop cycles!")

        print("\n==================================================")
        print("  ALL RELIABILITY ACCEPTANCE TESTS PASSED PERFECTLY!")
        print("==================================================")

    except Exception as ex:
        print(f"\n[FAILURE] Acceptance suite encountered error: {ex}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        # Clean shutdown of all running subprocesses
        for p in procs.values():
            terminate_process_tree(p)

        p_stop = subprocess.Popen(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-Command", ".\\Stop-Services.ps1"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
        p_stop.communicate()
        sys.exit(1)
    finally:
        # Clean temp DB files
        print("\nCleaning up temporary database files...")
        for db in [IDENTITY_DB_FILE, COMMERCE_DB_FILE, REVIEWS_DB_FILE]:
            if os.path.exists(db):
                try:
                    os.remove(db)
                    print(f"Deleted {db}")
                except Exception as e:
